newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Ciller to visit Jordan next week.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Ciller to visit Jordan next week.

text.p: Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller will next week visit Jordan, one of the few Arab countries which has not criticised Turkey's plan to set up a security zone in northern Iraq, the foreign ministry said on Friday.
The ministry said in a statement that the visit, which had been postponed from September 3 because of the crisis in Iraq, will take place next Tuesday and Wednesday.

Both countries allow U.S. planes to patrol no-fly zones over Iraq from their soil. Turkey has been criticised by much of the Arab world for a plan to establish a buffer zone in northern Iraq against Kurdish guerrillas.
